category_title: Students with IDD in ordinary classes experiencing social exclusion and academic differentiation
scenario_title: Academic differentiation leading to peer victimization in the ordinary classroom
minimal_context: The student is in an ordinary secondary class and is asked to work on academic tasks using differentiated materials.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please take out your book and start working on your activities and exercises.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I like the way teachers teach. But I don’t like some classmates. I did not get along well with some people in the ordinary class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just focus on your own work right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: They make fun of me because I use books from primary education. They laugh at me and hit me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to ignore them and keep trying to do your exercises.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: A girl insulted me, I told the TE (therapeutic educator). I have had some fights with some classmates at the canteen.
